member.name: T:IssueAgent.Providers.GitHub.GitHubProviderFactory
member.summary:
Builds a fully wired for one configured provider entry.
GitHub.com and GitHub Enterprise Server route REST and GraphQL differently. For github.com, ApiBaseUri is used as-is for REST and GraphQL lives at https://api.github.com/graphql. For an Enterprise Server host, Octokit automatically prefixes REST calls with api/v3/; this factory mirrors that convention for the raw timeline client and routes GraphQL to api/graphql, matching GitHub's documented Enterprise Server routing.

member.name: T:IssueAgent.Providers.GitHub.GitHubTimelineClient
member.summary: Reads the stable, generally-available Issue Timeline REST API to discover "cross-referenced" events, the only issue-relationship signal GitHub exposes without GraphQL sub-issue/project preview fields. Parent/child, blocks/blocked-by, and duplicate relationships require those additional preview APIs and are out of scope for this slice; see AGENTS.md follow-up tracking.
